snippet.title: Night Stocker Trailer
snippet.description:
From August 17-24, we're heading to the Ukrainian Games Festival.

This is our chance to invite you to immerse yourself in a world of total chaos. We hope you enjoy the game presentation and decide to add it to your wish list, as that would really help us promote the game.


Night Stocker is a fun organization game where you calmly tidy up a huge, cluttered retro media store. Arrange tapes, books, and board games on shelves with different themes. Experience the satisfaction of transforming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.
